items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know who Phil Stein was until the set was over and he asked me to come sit at a table with him.

ctx.x: a place here in by the name of the Old Banjo and they had jam sessions there and one time I sat in with the band and my rendition of "Jadda" brought tears to a gentleman by the name of Phil Stein. He had his wife with him and I didn't know who Phil Stein was until the set was over and he asked me to come sit at a table with him. So Phil Stein says to me, "Could I do your portrait?" I said, "Sure, you can do my portrait." And I thought he was kidding, I didn't know if he was serious or not. "I tell you what, you…

So to make a long story short, I went to his house and I brought my horn, wore a dark suit, and he took my pictures. "I thought you were going to do my portrait." He said, "I have to take pictures first." He took them in color.
